description: Recorded live on Claude Code 2.1.329 (interactive, tmux, `--settings` with a `statusLine` command and `refreshInterval: 2`): the JSON Claude pipes to a status line command on stdin, trimmed of usage fields and with local paths replaced. It carries the conversation's `session_id` (the same value the command's environment exports as `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID`), so `ovld status-line --agent claude --payload-file -` can look up the native-session index that attach wrote. The command's environment also inherits the launch environment (`OVERLORD_MISSION_ID`, `OVERLORD_OBJECTIVE_ID`) and `COLUMNS`. Claude runs the command at session start, after each assistant message and other UI events (debounced 300 ms, an in-flight run is cancelled) and every `refreshInterval` seconds; output is shown only after exit 0, and empty output leaves the line blank.
